new_tests.purpose: Validate L05 report renderer outputs, source index hashes, coverage CSV, missing metric visibility, and source-of-truth rejection for rendered metric sources.
Parse generated SVG views and assert semantic coverage heatmap, scale ladder, P13 timing waterfall, P14 dry-run, and missing diagnostic markers.
Validate CLI/schema generation and ensure CI includes L05 static report commands without P14 opt-in or real/fault wrapper execution.

new_cli_gates.acceptance: Generates all L05 report views and report_index.json from committed JSON artifacts.
Validates the generated L05 report index artifact.

new_artifact_checks: index.html links to source artifacts and generated report views.
coverage_matrix.csv contains one row per coverage_matrix.json entry with stable layer/surface ordering.
coverage_heatmap.svg contains a semantic cell per coverage matrix entry with status, layer, surface, real coverage, and dry-run attributes.
scale_ladder.svg renders P13 50/100 real rungs and P14 only as opt-in dry-run/skipped.
p13_timing_waterfall.svg renders P13 timing components from timing JSON and marks missing diagnostics explicitly.
missing_metrics.csv preserves MISSING, SKIPPED_WITH_REASON, and NO_BASELINE_YET rows with nonempty reasons.
report_index.json records hashes for sources and rendered views, and marks rendered views source_of_truth=false.

expected_initial_failures.reason: L05 renderer does not exist before implementation.
L05 report index schema and generated artifact do not exist before implementation.
Focused L05 report tests do not exist before harness creation and fail before renderer implementation.
Focused L05 visualization tests do not exist before harness creation and fail before renderer implementation.
L05 CI gate test does not exist before harness creation and fails before renderer implementation.

acceptance_criteria: Renderer, schema, report tests, visualization tests, CI guard, and generated report views exist.
Generated report_index.json validates against schema and records source and rendered hashes.
All rendered values come from machine-readable artifacts, not hardcoded report constants.
Missing and skipped metrics remain visible with reasons.
P14 remains dry-run/resource/planner only and is never shown as real coverage.
No L05 command invokes P14, VSLAB_ALLOW_1000_DRYRUN, scripts/valkey_e2e_gate.py, scripts/fault_safety_gate.py, or scripts/fault_failover_gate.py.
No historical phase/gate artifact is modified.
